title: An unfitted finite element method for elliptic interface problem with low regularity estimates
summary: In this paper, we present and analyze an unfitted finite element method for the elliptic interface problem. We consider the case that the interface is $C^2$-smooth or polygonal, and the exact solution $u \in H^{1+s}(Ω_0 \cup Ω_1)$ for any $s > 0$. The stability near the interface is guaranteed by a local polynomial extension technique combined with ghost penalty bilinear forms, from which the robust condition number estimates and the error estimates are derived.
